source: A useful L1 hit can reduce traffic to L2 and device memory. That matters because downstream interfaces are shared by more requesters and are farther from the issuing ZXNAME0000XZ. Nsight’s memory analysis reports requested sectors, misses to L2, hit rates, and link utilization precisely because a high-level “load count” does not reveal how much traffic escaped the first cache.[3]
zh: 有用的 L1 命中可以减少 L2 和设备内存的流量。这很重要，因为下游接口由更多请求者共享，并且距离发出 ZXNAME0000XZ 更远。 Nsight 的内存分析准确地报告请求的扇区、L2 未命中、命中率和链接利用率，因为高级“负载计数”并不能揭示有多少流量逃逸第一个缓存。 [3]
